blocks.html: Get eyes on the drone's live video, aim the camera, and pull a grid on what you see.

slides.title: Open the live video feed
slides.html: Tap Play on the UAS Tool home screen to open the Full Motion Video (FMV) feed and map. The drone's marker, its SPoI (Sensor Point of Interest) and camera field of view show on the map.

slides.title: Pan and tilt the camera
slides.html: Tap Gimbal Control to open the gimbal toolbar. Drag the Pan/Tilt sliders to aim the camera, and use Zoom In / Zoom Out to move in or out.

slides.title: Lock the gimbal
slides.html: Tap Gimbal Lock (item 7 on the lower toolbar) to fix the camera's yaw so it stays pointed and does not rotate with the drone.

slides.title: Switch thermal or visible
slides.html: Open the Camera options, tap Select Video Stream, and pick Frontal (visible) or Thermal. Use thermal in low light or to pick out heat.

slides.title: Read the crosshair (SPoI)
slides.html: The center crosshair marks where the camera is looking. It shows Grid Coordinates, the Range (slant distance to the point) and the Bearing (angle from the drone). Use this to call a grid.

slides.title: Snap the map to the drone
slides.html: Tap Pan-To to jump the map view to the drone's location. Long press Pan-To to lock the map to the drone marker so it follows along.

slides.title: Toggle full or half screen
slides.html: Tap the screen size button to switch between Half screen (big map, small video) and Full screen (big video with a mini-map). Tap it again to switch back.
